arguments.summary: Command and Control (C2) beaconing was detected from internal host WS-IT-101 (10.0.8.200), initially attributed to external IP 10.0.5.14. Further analysis revealed the true C2 relay node was 10.0.1.10, a domain controller being used as a reverse proxy. The attacker leveraged Cobalt Strike with a malleable C2 profile over HTTPS (JA3 hash: e7d705a3286e19ea42f587b344ee6865). A full endpoint scan identified 'Ransomware.WannaCry.Gen' on the compromised host. The helpdesk account (CORP\helpdesk) was revoked due to suspected lateral movement. The domain controller (10.0.1.10) was hardened via Ansible, and its outbound traffic to the C2 relay was blocked at the firewall.

timeline.description: Initial network scan from 10.0.8.200 to 10.0.2.15 detected and logged by IDS.
Successful authentication from 10.0.8.200 to domain controller 10.0.1.1 using CORP\helpdesk account.
C2 beaconing alert triggered. Initial misattribution to 10.0.5.14.
Analysis confirms true C2 relay at 10.0.1.10. Incident response initiated.
Firewall rule deployed to block outbound traffic to 10.0.1.10.
Full EPP scan on 10.0.8.200 detects and quarantines ransomware payload.
Credentials for CORP\helpdesk revoked due to suspected compromise.
Ansible playbook executed to harden domain controller 10.0.1.10.
